name: Poking Boop again and again keeps it angry
case: The person pokes Boop again and again, then again a minute later, and again a minute after that. Boop gets angry at the first round of pokes, and ends every round with a grumpy face (never a happy, excited or proud one), with a word like 'nope', 'ugh' or 'again', or none. It stays grumpy through the second round, which comes before it has calmed down, and the third round, after it has, climbs back to grumpy. A few minutes after the last poke it has calmed down: when the agent starts a turn, Boop is happy again.
why: PERSONALITY's Examples: three or more pokes in a row get a grumpy face with 'nope'; plan/steering/mood/happy.md and grumpy.md: three or more pokes in a row make Boop grumpy, more keep it so, and grumpy goes back to happy 2 minutes after the change, a single poke then being a fresh start. Every poke wakes the brain (harness/EVENTS.md §4); each step checks its round's last, four in a row
